plugin.notes: 2.8.3: a pairing code that expires after your phone paired no longer shows a confusing error; the panel says whether a phone used it. 2.8.2: the Cloudflare token you paste at setup is kept (encrypted) by default, so updating the relay doesn't ask for it again; the panel no longer stays blank when Orca is reloading the plugin (it says so and retries). 2.8.1: no one else can use your relay Worker. 2.8.0: list your phones and remove one at a time.

relay.notes: Relay 1.3.1: a placeholder or short RELAY_ADMIN_TOKEN is ignored (it can never become your relay's key), and malformed phone addresses are refused before they use your Durable Object quota. 1.3.0: per-phone keys.
